github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Write commit messages that are concise and describe the purpose of the change, not just what changed. Reference the AEM module (core, ui.apps, ui.content, ui.config, dispatcher, frontend) in the subject line when the change is scoped to one module.

github.copilot.chat.pullRequestDescripti.text: Draft PR descriptions with: (1) modules changed, (2) purpose of the change, (3) Cloud Manager or OakPAL risks if any, (4) SonarCloud or quality gate impact if any, (5) testing notes. Keep it factual and concise.
